DentalKart Careers at DentalKart Chat Expert Customer Experience | Live Chat Desk Location DentalKart Head Office Reports To Team Leader / Ops Manager – Customer Experience Primary Channel Live Chat (high concurrency), with working knowledge of Voice and Email Experience 1–4 years, with chat handling in logistics / last-mile / e-commerce ABOUT THE ROLE DentalKart is looking for a Chat Expert who thrives on live chat and can genuinely hold maximum concurrency — multiple real conversations running at once — without dropping quality, tone, or accuracy on any single one. This is a chat-first role, but we need someone whose skillset doesn't stop at chat: you should be equally comfortable jumping on a call or writing a clean email when a case needs it, and you should understand what happens end-to-end when an order or delivery goes wrong. You will be the first serious line of resolution for our customers — fast enough to keep multiple chats moving, and sharp enough to actually solve the problem instead of just replying quickly. WHAT YOU'LL OWN • Maximum concurrency chat handling: Running multiple live chats simultaneously at a high concurrency level, keeping every customer moving without generic copy-paste replies or long response gaps. • End-to-end escalation handling: Owning a query from first message to final resolution — order issues, delivery delays, refunds, or product concerns — rather than handing it off after the first response. • Voice and email fluency: Stepping onto a call when a chat needs a human voice to resolve faster, and writing precise, professional emails for cases that need a documented trail. • Logistics and last-mile understanding: Applying real knowledge of last-mile delivery, courier partners, and e-commerce order flows to give customers accurate updates instead of vague reassurances. • Judgment under load: Reading tone in a chat and adjusting your approach in real time — slowing down, acknowledging, or escalating internally — before a routine query turns into a complaint. • Documentation: Keeping chat, voice, and email interactions logged clearly and consistently, so context is never lost if a case is picked up by someone else. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 1–4 years in a live chat or blended support role, with proven experience managing high concurrency — not single-chat or low-volume queues. • Prior experience in logistics, last-mile delivery, courier, or e-commerce operations, with real understanding of how shipments, RTOs, and delivery exceptions work. • Comfortable handling voice calls and writing emails, not chat-only. • Expert-level typing speed and accuracy — able to type fast and correctly under pressure across several open chats. • Excellent written and spoken English, with the judgment to know when a chat should be escalated versus resolved directly. • Comfortable owning a case end-to-end rather than passing it along at the first sign of difficulty. GOOD TO HAVE • Familiarity with Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, or a similar helpdesk/CRM platform. • Exposure to dental, healthcare, or B2B e-commerce categories. • A track record of consistently high CSAT or chat resolution scores in a previous role. WHY THIS ROLE Chat is the highest-volume, highest-visibility channel in our CX operation, and the people who excel here are the ones who move fastest into escalation and team lead tracks. If you can genuinely handle volume without losing quality, this role is built to grow with you. DentalKart | Customer Experience Team Requirements • 1–4 years in a live chat or blended support role, with proven experience managing high concurrency — not single-chat or low-volume queues. • Prior experience in logistics, last-mile delivery, courier, or e-commerce operations, with real understanding of how shipments, RTOs, and delivery exceptions work. • Comfortable handling voice calls and writing emails, not chat-only. • Expert-level typing speed and accuracy — able to type fast and correctly under pressure across several open chats. • Excellent written and spoken English, with the judgment to know when a chat should be escalated versus resolved directly. • Comfortable owning a case end-to-end rather than passing it along at first sign of difficulty.

What You'll Own Escalation ownership: Escalated tickets across chat, email, and voice — taking over conversations that frontline agents have flagged as high-risk, high-emotion, or high-value. De-escalation on live chat: Reading a chat in real time and choosing the right de-escalation approach — acknowledging the issue, controlling pace, and closing the loop — instead of following a script word for word. Cross-team coordination: Coordinating with logistics partners (BlueDart, Delhivery, and others), warehouse, and returns teams to get a real answer for the customer, not a placeholder. Chat throughput: Typing fast and accurately enough to run concurrent chats without the customer feeling like they're waiting on you. Voice and email fluency: Speaking with customers directly when a matter needs a voice call instead of text, and writing clear, professional emails for cases that need a documented trail. Root-cause flagging: Flagging repeat escalation patterns (a courier, a SKU, a process gap) to the Team Lead instead of just closing tickets one by one. Documentation: Keeping every escalation logged with a clear resolution note, so nothing repeats itself or gets lost between shifts. What We're Looking For 2–5 years in a customer-facing escalation, resolution, or senior support role, with genuine exposure to a blended process (not chat-only or voice-only). Prior experience in logistics, courier, or e-commerce operations, where you've actually dealt with delayed orders, failed deliveries, refunds, or shipment disputes. A track record of calming down an upset customer on chat in real time — not just following an escalation matrix. Expert-level typing speed and accuracy, comfortable managing multiple live chats at once. Excellent spoken and written English — confident on calls, clear and error-free over email. A calm, sharp presence under pressure. You don't get rattled, and you don't let a customer's tone dictate yours. Champion in follow ups for timely resolution. Have knowledge about the product journey and the return functiality. Good to Have Familiarity with Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, or a similar helpdesk/CRM platform. Exposure to dental, healthcare, or B2B e-commerce categories. Prior experience mentoring or coaching frontline agents on tone and de-escalation. Versant 5 certification. Requirements Good to Have Familiarity with Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, or a similar helpdesk/CRM platform. Exposure to dental, healthcare, or B2B e-commerce categories. Prior experience mentoring or coaching frontline agents on tone and de-escalation. Versant 5 certification.

GOOD TO HAVE • Experience with tools like Jira, Confluence, Figma, SQL, Tableau/Power BI. • Familiarity with GenAI tooling (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Lovable, Kiro) for rapid prototyping. • Experience managing or working closely with cross-functional PODs members.

Retention Marketing Lead Lifecycle and CRM Reports to: VP Marketing Location: Delhi NCR (on-site) Team: you will shape and lead the retention function Experience: 5+ years Compensation: Competitive, commensurate with experience About Dentalkart Dentalkart is India's leading online dental marketplace. We supply the dentists, clinics, and labs that run the country's oral healthcare, from single-chair practices to multi-clinic groups, alongside a fast-growing base of everyday consumers. Waldent, our own brand, sits inside the catalog. Because dental practices reorder on a predictable cycle, the right merchandising, retention, and category decisions compound month after month. We are building a new, owner-led marketing structure, and this is one of five leadership seats in it. Why this role exists Dental practices reorder on a cycle, which makes retention the economic engine of this business, not acquisition. You own the second purchase, the tenth purchase, and everything that keeps a customer buying. This seat exists because lifetime value is where the margin lives, and it has been under-owned until now. What you own • Customer lifetime value and the LTV-to-CAC ratio • Repeat purchase rate and retention across cohorts • The full customer journey and the lifecycle communication behind it: onboarding, replenishment, reactivation, win-back • Nudges that recover customers dropping at any funnel stage, in-app and across channels What you will do • Build lifecycle journeys in MoEngage across email (Kasplo), WhatsApp and RCS (Onextel), SMS (Gupshup), and push, mapped to where each customer sits in their buying cycle • Segment customers (RFM, category, practice type, B2B versus consumer) and run targeted retention and replenishment programmes • Locate the funnel drop-off points and deploy nudges that recover them, measured by recovered revenue • Build and own a reactivation and win-back engine for lapsed buyers • Stand up the retention metric stack (cohort retention, repeat rate, lifetime value, LTV-to-CAC) so the whole org reads the same numbers • Partner with Merchandising on WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 1–4 years in a live chat or blended support role, with proven experience managing high concurrency — not single-chat or low-volume queues. • Prior experience in logistics, last-mile delivery, courier, or e-commerce operations, with real understanding of how shipments, RTOs, and delivery exceptions work. • Comfortable handling voice calls and writing emails, not chat-only. • Expert-level typing speed and accuracy — able to type fast and correctly under pressure across several open chats. • Excellent written and spoken English, with the judgment to know when a chat should be escalated versus resolved directly. • Comfortable owning a case end-to-end rather than passing it along at the first sign of difficulty. GOOD TO HAVE • Familiarity with Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, or a similar helpdesk/CRM platform. • Exposure to dental, healthcare, or B2B e-commerce categories. • A track record of consistently high CSAT or chat resolution scores in a previous role. WHY THIS ROLE Chat is the highest-volume, highest-visibility channel in our CX operation, and the people who excel here are the ones who move fastest into escalation and team lead tracks. If you can genuinely handle volume without losing quality, this role is built to grow with you.
